summary: Ten labels print alpha-linolenic acid at 50 mg to 2.5 g, in eight as the fatty acid fraction beside an oil or other omega rows and in two (Brainy Chews, 50 mg) as a bare row. The largest trial (20929341, 1.9 g in margarine) was null on its primary outcome, a flaxseed oil trial (30392473, 4.7 g) was null on blood pressure, and a 2.2 g flaxseed oil trial (36986229) moved one of its cognitive tests. Cochrane (32114706) finds little or no difference for mortality and coronary events with small signals on events and arrhythmia.
